email_body:
Hello,

I saw your Technical and Asset Officer advert on SEEK and would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, carrying out inspections and quality checks and coordinating crews, subcontractors and suppliers. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for regional work.

Your advert mentions quantities and cost estimates for minor works and managing Before You Dig enquiries, both of which I did in my course. I have not used survey instruments or GIS on a job yet, and I am open to discussing relocation to Cummins.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a short call about the role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application: Technical and Asset Officer
paragraphs: I saw your SEEK advert for a Technical and Asset Officer in the Works team at Cummins, and I would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, documenting road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries, followed its procedures and designed around existing services and site constraints, and my coursework covered cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I carried out site inspections and quality checks, reviewed drawings against the work, coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day and kept site reports and material records.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have not used survey instruments or GIS software on a job, and my design experience is from study, so I would start at entry level. I am open to discussing relocation to Cummins for this role.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about how I could support your Works team.
